title: Choose local presentation and return with keyboard focus
description: A developer operates the actual shared game menu/settings in the gallery, reloads local choices, and inspects the existing shared feedback lab. These are acknowledged browser-local outcomes, not campaign receipts, galaxy rail/scene equivalence or performance evidence. No identity or emulator setup is used.

steps.description: Open the shared menu with Enter and cycle every modal control with Tab and Shift+Tab.
steps.acknowledgement: The native modal owns focus and explains browser-local scope.
verifications: Both complete labelled controls and the close action are contained and readable before any auto-scroll.
OS reduction applies even with the local checkbox off.

steps.description: With the device allowing motion, enable both local reductions through Space; then return to the capture environment.
steps.acknowledgement: Both local choices are checked and persisted by the production settings code.
verifications: Both complete labelled controls and the close action are contained and readable before any auto-scroll.
Lower detail has a named local acknowledgement.

steps.description: Close with Escape, verify opener focus, reload and reopen the saved settings. Turn off the local motion override while the device still requests reduction.
steps.acknowledgement: The saved detail choice survives reload and OS reduction cannot be disabled locally.
verifications: Both complete labelled controls and the close action are contained and readable before any auto-scroll.

steps.description: Restore full decoration and explicitly return from the menu with Enter; keyboard focus returns to Menu.
steps.acknowledgement: The menu closes and restores its original opening control.
verifications: Both explicit local overrides are now off; device reduction remains effective.

steps.description: Open the existing feedback lab and seek the same accepted identity result in both paused motion presentations.
steps.acknowledgement: Both actual Feedback components show the same accepted outcome.
verifications: Both accepted comparisons distinguish no recovery action from their successful Identity saved outcome.
The production menu is present in the shared lab; playback is paused and no live campaign is involved.
The named comparison and accepted outcome are wholly visible in their explicit reading view.
Explicit paused motion: [aria-label="Standard motion comparison"], 1 animation(s), 90/180 ms; unchanged exact comparison.
Explicit paused motion: [aria-label="Reduced motion comparison"], 1 animation(s), 180/180 ms; unchanged exact comparison.
